data.narrative:
Carbyon is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised €22.3M to date. The valuation analysis is set against a Climate & Energy peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (Linz, ticker LNZA), though a narrow set of same-stage and adjacent-stage peers limits methodological options.

Stage-progression analysis, the primary applicable method, anchors valuation using the €22.3M total raised as a proxy for current implied value. Applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier between Series A and the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of €45M. This method is the only quantitative approach supported by sufficient data; peer-median triangulation was inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Climate & Energy sector (fewer than three datapoints survived stage and tier filtering).

The analysis supports a valuation range of €38M (low) to €51M (high), centered on a median of €45M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x step-up multiplier for this specific sector and stage, given the sparse comparable set, and the absence of direct same-stage peer data to validate stage-progression assumptions. Additional revenue, burn rate, or technology-readiness metrics would strengthen conviction in this range.
